text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hmm… ah! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big brother! Found you!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big sister! Found you!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hehe…! You know, you always hide here. Buu-chan knows it well!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Before I knew it, I’d remembered everything. The things you like, the things you don’t. Even little habits, naturally. All of it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …That was just “normal.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Ah, you’re still working. Hehe, good work.
choice_data_list: <size=32>Buena, were you running until this late too?</size>
<size=32>Buena, were you running until this late?</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And you know, during my self-training, I found something…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! What do you think this is?
choice_data_list: <size=32>…Ah! The ice cream we used to eat!</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Correct! You liked it, but we haven’t seen it for a while. They revived it. Want to eat together?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we ate it enough times to remember. So, how’s the preparation for the trainer study session? Tough?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …I see. Hey, is there anything I can help with? Tell me anything! I’ll work hard with you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um, this is the room for the trainer study session…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …You said you were nervous, but… are you okay? Maybe I can peek a little—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmm… ah, there you are! …Looks like you’re talking to another trainer?

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text: Long time no see! How’ve you been!? Huh? When did we meet last? It’s been forever, right?
choice_data_list: <size=32>You say that every time we meet</size>
<size=32>You say that every time we meet</size>

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hahhaa! Getting tired of it? Hey, stop. Don’t give me that look!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So you make that kind of face too…?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …How rare…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…The study session has started. But Trainer-san being the first presenter…!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Everyone’s watching. It’s so quiet… please… do your best…!)

text_block_list.name: Mid-career Trainer
text_block_list.text: …A question about that training method. Setting aside the leg burden, how are you determining the transition timing?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…Such a sharp question…!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (To answer properly in this situation…!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! Ah… huh? You seem… fine?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text: Um! Your presentation earlier was really helpful…! I have something I’d like to ask… may I!?
choice_data_list: <size=32>Sure, please send it to this address</size>

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey! There’s a drinking party after this! You’re coming, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A drinking party…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …………I see.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …That’s the trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hehe, thinking about it, it’s obvious, isn’t it? We haven’t been together all the time.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: There are things I don’t know, faces I haven’t seen—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …………I never saw… that face.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …………Big brother.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …………Big sister.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Did you… go a little farther away?
